reviewSlices.label: Versioned prompts and dual-person review ledger
questions: Do prompt version digests, immutable scope and independent review prevent tenant instructions from becoming platform system prompts?
Is the reviewed ledger demonstrably disposable and NOT mistaken for production approved prompt governance?
reviewSlices.requiredEvidence: Independent source review of version integrity, role separation, irreversible release hold and local-only SQL boundaries

reviewSlices.label: Server Auth, session binding and allowlisted tools
questions: Is the actor always server resolved and is fallback tenant or service-role binding forbidden?
Is ai_read_current_bound_session_v1 intentionally uninstalled, and does no model/browser-controlled callback execute?
reviewSlices.requiredEvidence: Independent review of signed Auth/session requirements, RPC reachability/owner/grants, logout races, direct binding and no live tool dispatch

reviewSlices.label: Real-schema minimal output and Knowledge source stop
questions: Do title/stage mappings match real courses/course_batches/leads and reject unprojected PII and cross-tenant rows?
Is all live Knowledge retrieval prohibited until active source metadata, verified consent and withdrawal are independently established?
reviewSlices.requiredEvidence: Independent verification of actual migrations, course capability, allowlisted fields and stale/untrusted Knowledge isolation

reviewSlices.label: Disposable read transaction and RLS rehearsal
questions: Do disposable safeguards reject real CRM databases and are current Auth, tenant, capability and resource checks inside one local transaction?
Does privileged SECURITY DEFINER bypass render local RLS tests insufficient as production evidence?
reviewSlices.requiredEvidence: Independent owner/grant/definer/invoker and concurrency assessment before any real SQL design; no hosted migration

reviewSlices.label: Audit commit ordering and idempotent retry
questions: Is it explicit that mock commit receipts cannot prove durable audit or authorize model-visible data?
Are replayed request IDs scope-bound and are uncertain COMMIT, rollback, cancellation, and denied-attempt retention unresolved production decisions?
reviewSlices.requiredEvidence: Independent review of commit ACK semantics, same-transaction read+audit, idempotency and privacy/legal retention

reviewSlices.label: Privacy, protected release and independent witness hold
reviewSlices.independentReviewFunction: Privacy/legal, infrastructure and independent release owner
questions: Have all nine AI-09H owner decisions been independently approved? Current expected answer: NO.
Has an isolated owner-approved test project and 16 independent real signed-user witnesses been accepted? Current expected answer: NO.
reviewSlices.requiredEvidence: Independent protected approvals for #601 #612 #613 #614, purpose/retention/erasure, environment protection, migration/rollback and release
